Class CssStyleResolver

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.css.cascade.CssStyleResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
StylePropertyResolver
public final class CssStyleResolver extends Object implements StylePropertyResolver
Represents the computed style for an element after CSS cascade resolution.

Implements StylePropertyResolver to allow typed property access using PropertyKeys. Properties can be retrieved either through the legacy typed getters (e.g., foreground()) or through the generic get(PropertyKey) method.

Example usage with PropertyKey: 

CssStyleResolver style = cascadeResolver.resolve(element, rules);
Color borderColor = style.get(StandardPropertyKeys.BORDER_COLOR).orElse(Color.WHITE);

      public <T> Optional<T> get(PropertyKey<T> key)
      Retrieves a typed property value using the given property key.

      Standard properties (color, background, border-color, text-align, border-type) are retrieved from dedicated fields. Other properties are looked up in additionalProperties and converted using the key's converter.

    • withFallback

      public CssStyleResolver withFallback(CssStyleResolver fallback)
      Creates a new resolver that uses this resolver's properties but falls back to the given resolver for CSS-inheritable properties not set in this resolver.

      Per CSS semantics, only certain properties inherit from parent to child:

      • Inheritable: color (foreground), text-style (modifiers), border-type
      • Non-inheritable: spacing, flex, direction, margin, padding, alignment, width, background
      Parameters:
      fallback - the fallback resolver for missing inheritable properties
      Returns:
      a new resolver with fallback behavior for inheritable properties only
